jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The User Researcher role ⭐️ At Alan, research is not a checkpoint. It's a compass. That means running interviews, diary studies, surveys, and usability sessions throughout the full product cycle, not just at the end. You'll then turn those findings into insights that are clear, compelling, and genuinely useful to the teams who need them. jobs.title: Home Based Primary Care Physician (MD/DO)
jobs.description: Practice medicine where it can matter most: in the home. Clover Health is looking for exceptional, mission-driven physicians to join our field-based In-Home Care team. In this role, you will care for Medicare Advantage members with complex medical, functional, and social needs — many of whom are older, medically fragile, and at high risk for avoidable complications. This is not transactional care. This is relationship-centered, outcomes-driven medicine. As a Field-Based Staff Physician, you will be accountable for the health outcomes of a defined panel of members. You will meet patients where they are, understand the realities of their home environment, identify risks early, and help coordinate the right care at the right time. You will have the autonomy to practice thoughtfully, the support of an interdisciplinary team, and the technology to act with greater insight and precision. We are seeking physicians who are highly accountable, clinically strong, operationally effective, and deeply committed to doing what is best for vulnerable seniors. Why this role matters Many of the patients we serve are navigating multiple chronic conditions, recent hospitalizations, fragmented care, limited resources, and the challenges that come with aging. For these members, the home is often where the most important clinical information lives. In this role, you will have the opportunity to see the full picture: the medications on the kitchen table, the caregiver dynamics, the fall risks, the barriers to follow-up, and the early warning signs that may never surface in a clinic visit. Your work will directly influence whether members recover safely, remain stable, avoid unnecessary hospitalizations, close care gaps, and feel supported by a care team that genuinely knows them. jobs.title: Product Owner / Produktmanager*in (m/w/d) Digital Health
jobs.description: Digitale Gesundheitslösungen verändern, wie Menschen versorgt werden – sicher, nutzerzentriert und evidenzbasiert. Als Product Owner (m/w/d) führst du unsere Digital-Health-Produkte von der ersten Idee bis zum Release und sorgst dafür, dass aus komplexen Anforderungen funktionierende Medizin- oder Präventionsprodukte mit echter Wirkung werden. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kund*innen, Design, Entwicklung, QA und Projektmanagement zusammen, übernimmst Ownership für Konzept, Priorisierung und Produktstrategie und prägst gleichzeitig unsere internen Produktmanagement-Standards aktiv mit. Aufgaben Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund*innen und einem interdisziplinären Team aus einer ersten Idee ein marktreifes digitales Produkt – von Discovery über Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei planst und moderierst du selbstständig Discovery-Workshops und formulierst daraus klare Anforderungen und Produktentscheidungen. Während der Konzeption entwickelst du zielgruppenspezifische Lösungen anhand von Wireframes und validierst diese z.B. durch Nutzerinterviews und Nutzertests. Du formulierst Epics und User Stories, definierst testbare Akzeptanzkriterien, priorisierst Backlogs, bewertest Aufwände gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam, machst Abnahmen und begleitest die Umsetzung. Du koordinierst die Ausgestaltung von Design und Softwarearchitektur in Abstimmung mit Kund*innen und weiteren Stakeholdern. Zusammen mit dem Projektmanagement planst du die Umsetzung hinsichtlich Timeline und Budget und koordinierst die erforderlichen Aufwände im Team. Du planst und begleitest Livegänge und verantwortest die Store-Releases. Du dokumentierst den Featurescope entsprechend regulatorischer Vorgaben gemäß ISO 13485 / IEC 62304. Du bringst dich über einzelne Projekte hinaus ein, entwickelst Methoden, Prozesse und unsere interne Produktmanagement-Praxis weiter, setzt KI-Tools an relevanten Stellen deiner Arbeit sicher ein, teilst Wissen und denkst aktiv an Schnittstellen und Strukturen mit. Qualifikation

Wir verbinden moderne Technologien, hochwertige Behandlungen und eine persönliche Betreuung, um unseren Kund erstklassige Ergebnisse zu ermöglichen. Für unseren Standort in Hamburg im Westfield Hamburg-Überseequartier suchen wir eine engagierte und kundenorientierte Kosmetikerin oder einen engagierten Kosmetiker, die oder der unser Team verstärkt und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen möchte. Deine Aufgaben Beratung und Kundenbetreuung Du führst professionelle Beratungsgespräche sowie Haut- und Körperanalysen durch. Du verstehst die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unserer Kund und berätst sie zu geeigneten Behandlungen. Du erklärst Behandlungsabläufe, mögliche Ergebnisse und die richtige Nachsorge verständlich und kompetent. Du baust durch deine freundliche Art und deine fachliche Kompetenz langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf. Durchführung von Behandlungen Du führst Laser-Haarentfernungen sowie weitere Haut-, Körper- und ästhetische Behandlungen entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und unserer angebotenen Leistungen durch. Du arbeitest nach unseren Behandlungsstandards, Protokollen und Sicherheitsvorgaben. Du sorgst für eine angenehme Behandlungsatmosphäre sowie für höchste Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards. Du dokumentierst die Behandlungen sorgfältig und gibst deinen Kund passende Nachsorgeempfehlungen. Qualität, Sicherheit und Geräte Du beachtest alle geltenden Sicherheits-, Hygiene- und Behandlungsrichtlinien. Du erkennst mögliche Kontraindikationen und klärst offene Fragen vor der Behandlung. Kundenbindung und Teamarbeit Du sorgst für ein hochwertiges Kundenerlebnis vom ersten Beratungsgespräch bis zur Nachbetreuung. Du empfiehlst passende Behandlungspläne

jobs.title: Data Manager
jobs.description: Company Overview DeepHealth, a RadNet company, is focused on delivering AI-powered solutions that improve population health, optimize radiology workflows, and drive earlier detection of disease. Our portfolio spans breast, lung, brain, prostate, and thyroid imaging AI, deployed across enterprise imaging platforms and large screening programs. Job Summary Data is a strategic asset at every phase of product development, and the Data Team’s role is to put it at the center of all stakeholders’ workflows. The Associate Data Manager will join a team that has built solid experience managing multiple products in parallel, with shared tooling and processes across products and modalities. The team’s pipelines continue to evolve to meet new challenges like data export and dataset creation. Strong bridges with our AI and Software teams fuel constant knowledge sharing and technical upskilling. As a member of the Data Team, the Associate Data Manager will collaborate closely with Radiologists, Product Managers, AI Engineers, Clinical Research Scientists and Software Developers to build and improve our medical products. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: • Design and maintain efficient tooling (pipelines, dashboards, automation) for the Data Team itself as well as for any stakeholder who needs to access, explore, or leverage the data. • Surface actionable insights from the data lake by identifying, structuring, and delivering relevant information to stakeholders across product, AI, and clinical teams. • Join at least one squad and be the Data expert. • Participate in the targeting and collection of relevant data. • Build and structure medically consistent and representative datasets. • Establish relevant annotation guidelines and training to ensure annotation quality. • Be a stakeholder in the ongoing overseeing and refinement of AI algorithm performances. jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description: General Summary The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US. jobs.title: Roving Clinic Nurse
jobs.description: About the role Remedy Skintech, Inc. is seeking an experienced Roving Clinic Nurse to join our dynamic team in Metro Manila. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you will play a crucial role in providing high-quality nursing care and support to our patients in an aesthetic clinic setting. What you'll be doing Deliver high-quality laser procedures to our patients Assist on doctors' procedures In charge of post-op procedures like equipment maintenance patients' post-treatment protocols Undergo training for all Remedy treatments Collaborating with the team to coordinate patient care and facilitate a smooth patient experience Providing patient education and promoting healthy behaviours to support positive health outcomes Maintaining a clean, safe, and well-organised clinical environment What we offer At Remedy Skintech, Inc., we value our employees and strive to create a supportive, collaborative work environment. As a Roving Clinic Nurse, you can expect competitive salary, and opportunities for professional development and career advancement. About us Remedy Skintech, Inc. is a leading provider of advanced dermatological services and skincare products in the Philippines. Our mission is to empower individuals to achieve their healthiest, most radiant skin through innovative treatments and personalized care. With a team of experienced medical professionals and a state-of-the-art facility, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient outcomes and an unparalleled customer experience. If you're passionate about nursing and committed to making a difference in the lives of our patients, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
